configurePresets.name: vs2026
configurePresets.description: The documented build. Same as: cmake -B build -G "Visual Studio 18 2026" -A x64

configurePresets.name: ninja
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja Multi-Config (IDE or Developer Command Prompt only)
configurePresets.description: Faster, and the only preset that produces compile_commands.json for clangd. Needs cl.exe on PATH: Visual Studio and VS Code arrange that when they open the folder; from a terminal you need a Developer Command Prompt or vcvars64.bat. Ninja itself ships with Visual Studio, so it is not an extra prerequisite.

configurePresets.name: ci
configurePresets.description: No generator on purpose. The dev box pins Visual Studio 18 2026; the runner image ships whatever it ships, and letting CMake pick its default keeps CI working across image updates instead of breaking the day the image moves.

configurePresets.name: options-off
configurePresets.description: The modularity claim, kept honest. Configure only: with a backend switched off the sandbox does not compile, because its DXC and PNG includes are unguarded. That is a real gap and a separate one - these presets check that the CMake graph stays coherent.
